_comment: Whatever comes and goes, coming more often. `frequency` is one name on the curtain, the bow, the rain and
every phenomenon, so this is the same word about all of them: a curtain most nights, rain most of the time, a
tempest's bolts and a sandfall's columns coming quicker. `frequent tempest` is the tempest's alone. A rung
counts things in space and never says how often; this does.
Laid bare it never brings a curtain or a bow into an Age that had none. It replaced `restless` (retired.json).
